known_limitations: Marburg Z/K additions are asserted by Zurich catalogue but their exact wordings remain NULL until both witness images are examined.
1530 Diet presentation copy must not be treated as identical to 1531 Ed.1; 1531 Ed.1 and Ed.2 are separate objects.
CR 26 printed 1858 page images are a later editorial witness, not photographed 1531 or 1540 imprints.
Schaff transcription is a later textual presentation and is not a photograph of 1531 Ed.1.
Original 16c evidence is not yet signoff-quality; original_witness_collated remains false.
